summary_markdown: The discussion focused on integrating demographic data for a specific client/project (rzk) into the campaign manager. The site side has implemented the necessary logic to generate area-based demographics, but the Campaign Manager is returning empty data. A key technical issue identified was that only one master facility exists. To resolve this and ensure proper data aggregation, it was determined that districts need to be specified within the facilities. This effort requires updating the UI and integrating the demographic data into existing aggregates, specifically addressing issues with `total-traffic` not connecting correctly.
decisions: Demographics for rzk must be implemented in the campaign manager.
Districts need to be properly specified within the facilities.
action_items: [me] will proceed with implementing the necessary changes (estimated completion within a week).
